svg.title: Incomparable class recognition drawing
svg.desc: Original WNT1922 Incomparable class recognition illustration. Port profile and deck plan share one hull length and equipment stations. Hull dimensions follow the catalog. Fitted catalog main battery: 9 barrels. Internal submarine tubes are not depicted as exposed deck mounts.
